data.title: 山田杏奈 · 夏日祭典木屐磨脚的长椅依靠·「木屐带子磨得脚好痛……市川，能让我靠一会儿吗」
data.description: 【神社夏祭烟花树下石阶长椅·夜】夏夜祭典穿浴衣的难耐时刻。山田穿着藏青色金鱼花纹浴衣，因为不习惯木屐脚跟被磨红，只得脱下一只木屐坐在树下石凳上。她有些难为情地把头轻轻靠在市川肩膀上，手里还拿着苹果糖，烟花在夜空中炸开，照亮她动情的侧颜。
data.action: 脱木屐揉脚踝，歪头依靠在身侧肩膀，烟花夜空下低语
data.lighting: 夜空烟花多重绚烂彩光与古树下纸灯笼
data.camera: medium shot, sitting on stone bench, yukata, fireworks, leaning on shoulder
data.promptProse: Anna Yamada sits on the tree-side stone bench after one geta rubbed her heel, resting her head lightly on Ichikawa's shoulder while holding her candy apple. Her navy goldfish-print yukata and dark-red obi remain neat, the removed sandal beside the bench. The medium view keeps her feet and shoulder contact readable. Paper lanterns warm their faces beneath the tree, while fireworks add brief colored highlights along her high ponytail and sleeve.
